newsitem.title: JAPAN: NCB says 5-yr debenture issue volume halved in Jan.
newsitem.headline: NCB says 5-yr debenture issue volume halved in Jan.

text.p: Nippon Credit Bank Ltd (NCB) said on Wednesday it issued about 30 billion yen worth of five-year bank debentures in January, about half the usual amount.
Vice president Shoji Nishikawa told reporters the bank plans to continue holding down the volume of its new debenture issues.
He also said it hopes the market will stabilise.
NCB's January 2.15 percent five-year debenture was traded at a yield of 4.10 percent on Tuesday in the secondary market. It was offered at 4.10 percent on Wednesday.

Bond market players attribute the sharp rise in the NCB debenture yield to recent weakness in Tokyo share prices, especially in the banking sector, which had reignited concerns about NCB's asset quality problem. -- Tokyo Treasury Desk +81-33432-9780
